skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts, theories, and principles of spatial development planning.
Apply knowledge to analyze and develop urban planning strategies.
Apply knowledge to analyze and develop rural planning strategies.
Understand the theories and principles of economic geography and their application in development planning.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and propose innovative solutions in development planning.
Effectively present and defend ideas and solutions in development planning.
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and present planning solutions.
Manage and organize the development planning process effectively.
Solve complex problems related to development planning.
Conduct research and analyze data relevant to development planning.

prerequisite_courses: Kế hoạch hóa kinh tế quốc dân
